guide.lead: Everything this app can do, and how, step by step. It works without internet.
guide.emergency.title: In an emergency
guide.emergency.1: **Plug in the charger** if you can. Keep the computer plugged in when possible.
guide.emergency.2: Press **Start survival mode** (at the top of Home, or in **Mode**). The emergency screen opens with the basics.
guide.emergency.3: Use **Chat**, **Library**, **Maps** and **First aid** (press **F** on Home). Everything works without internet.
guide.emergency.4: If something says it has a problem, press the button next to it. Every problem has a code like **LAI-SVC-001** and one sentence that says what to do.
guide.can.title: What this app can do
guide.can.chat: **Chat**: type a question and the AI answers. It knows a lot about health, repairs, food and water.
guide.can.photo: **Ask about a photo**: take or choose a photo and ask about it (a plant, a wound, a label).
guide.can.talk: **Talk**: speak your question and hear the answer read aloud.
guide.can.library: **Library**: Wikipedia, medical books and how-to guides, all on this computer.
guide.can.maps: **Maps**: an offline map with place search.
guide.can.manuals: **Manuals**: the printable instructions for this computer, including the Survival card.
guide.can.status: **Status and battery**: is everything working, how much battery is left, and what is wrong.
guide.can.brain: **Switch brain**: choose another AI model, for example a faster one or one that understands photos.
guide.can.firstaid: **First aid**: CPR, choking, bleeding, burns and more. It is not a doctor: if any phone works, call the emergency number.
guide.can.mode: **Mode**: Online (uses the internet), Offline (no internet) or Survival (the emergency screen). Leaving survival mode needs no PIN.
guide.can.content: **Offline content**: what is on this computer, updating it from the internet, copying from the AI-ARK drive, and removing the drive safely.
guide.can.models: **AI models**: which AI models are on this computer, which one is in use, and downloading or removing them.
guide.can.health: **Health**: a full check of the computer, recent events, and a practice drill.
guide.can.system: **System**: versions, restarting a part that is stuck, updating Local AI, and the rebuild kit.
guide.can.pin: Only removing content or AI models asks for the **admin PIN**. Everything else works without it.
guide.tasks.title: Step by step
guide.task.survivalOn.title: Start survival mode
guide.task.survivalOn.1: On Home, press **Start survival mode** (in the blue band at the top).
guide.task.survivalOn.2: Wait a moment. The emergency screen opens full screen.
guide.task.survivalOff.title: Leave survival mode (when the emergency is over)
guide.task.survivalOff.1: At the top right, press **Leave survival mode**.
guide.task.survivalOff.2: Choose **Online** if there is internet, or **Offline** if there is not.
guide.task.survivalOff.3: Press **Leave survival mode**. No PIN is needed. The normal screen comes back.
guide.task.offline.title: Stop using the internet (go offline)
guide.task.offline.2: Press **Use Offline**, read what changes, and press **Use Offline** again.
guide.task.update.title: Update the content (needs internet)
guide.task.update.2: Press **Sync now**. The list shows what is downloading. You can keep using the computer.
guide.task.update.3: It also happens by itself every night while the computer is Online.
guide.task.import.title: Copy everything from the AI-ARK drive
guide.task.import.1: Plug in the AI-ARK drive and wait one minute.
guide.task.import.2: On Home, press **Offline content**. The drive appears under **Drives**.
guide.task.import.3: Press **Copy from this drive**. Nothing on this computer is deleted.
guide.task.eject.title: Remove the AI-ARK drive safely
guide.task.eject.2: Next to the drive, press **Eject safely**.
guide.task.eject.3: Unplug it only when the screen says it is safe.
guide.task.health.title: Check that everything works
guide.task.health.1: On Home, press **Health**, then **Run a full check**.
guide.task.health.2: Each problem shows a code, one sentence that says what to do, and often a button that does it.
guide.task.appUpdate.title: Update Local AI (needs internet)
guide.task.appUpdate.1: On Home, press **System**, then **Update Local AI**.
guide.task.appUpdate.2: The computer asks for its login password. Type it and wait until it says it is done.
guide.task.colors.title: What the colours at the top mean
guide.task.colors.2: **Amber ! Ready, with problems**: the basics work; **Next step** says what to do.
guide.task.colors.3: **Red ✗ Not ready**: chat or the library does not work. Press the button under **Next step**, or restart the computer and wait 2 minutes.
guide.manuals.title: Manuals
guide.manuals.lead: The full printed instructions for this computer, in English and Spanish.
guide.expert.title: For an expert
guide.expert.lead: The same tasks typed in a terminal (Ctrl + Alt + T). Nobody else needs this.
guide.expert.library: If the app cannot open, the library is also at http://127.0.0.1:7070/library/ in a web browser on this computer.
